cards.title: Should we move closer to family before school?
cards.body: A parent seeks advice on relocating near family support before their daughter starts school. The expert weighs the benefits of proximity against the costs of uprooting, including lost friendships and new challenges.

cards.title: Music snobbery: what kids taught me
cards.body: A parent discovers that dismissing their children's musical tastes was misguided. The experience reveals how kids develop genuine appreciation for music, even if it differs from parental preferences.

cards.title: Face-to-face contact with surrogates matters
cards.body: Weekly in-person meetings with your surrogate can significantly improve the surrogacy journey. These interactions create shared experiences and may help prevent complications down the road.

cards.title: Schools told to prioritize learning over GCSE prep
cards.body: The government is directing secondary schools to focus on richer, more engaging education for younger students. Year 7-9 pupils should not be preparing for GCSEs before Year 10.
